body.x: Innopresso (CEO Cho Eun-hyeong) participated in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its touchpad-integrated keyboard Mokibo.

Innopresso is a company that studies how toteach and expand the input device Mokibo, which will become the nextmainstream. Mokibo is an integrated keyboard with the ability to convert from aplain mechanical keyboard plane to a large touchpad. Since the mechanicalkeyboard touch is preserved, fast typing is made possible. In addition, sincethe touchpad is three times larger than the typical notebook touchpad, it ishighly usable as a portable keyboard, a tablet PC keyboard, and a laptopkeyboard module.

Major features are as follows. △ Convertsthe keyboard itself into a large touch pad △ Integrated keyboard with thesmallest product size even though it has the largest keyboard size amongintegrated keyboard and the largest touch pad size △ Less arm movement whenswitching between keyboard and mouse modes △ Shortest switching time betweenkeyboard mode and mouse mode

CEO Cho said, "We have now created thefirst generation keyboard, the touchpad module in the second and thirdgeneration, and we have completed the development of a laptop keyboard modulethat can be used in future laptops from large companies such as Apple and HP.And at CES, we have been attracting attention from various companies includingApple, Microsoft, and others.”
He also added, “We will work with them tomake sure that more users can experience Mokibo in the future.”

The world’s largest IT show CES shows thetrend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted byConsumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
